authorization: Parent authorized bounded qualification after both routing acceptance gates; production promotion remains separate.

owners.android: android_delivery owns Kotlin native producer, app/core integration behind explicit QA policy and actual capture.
owners.apple: apple_delivery owns Swift counterpart, explicit QA policy and actual capture.
owners.immersion: immersion_engine owns data/compiler/proof and semantic review of captured spans; no concurrent platform edits.
owners.root: Root inspects manifest, confirms routing gates, controls production promotion.

schema_notes: Read pairs[en-target].entries only as candidate mappings; noneligible/provenance sections are audit data.
Every entry has id,source,target,category,pos,train_rank,source_tokens; optional guard/following, mandatory JA reading/reading_kana.
Do not infer dictionary proof from a missing primary_evidence_sha256. Authored Sw question units have explicit provenance with exact rule/review bindings.
Compute/verify exact asset SHA before use. Use that SHA and stable entry ID in SourceReferenceUnit; include pack version in caches.
Japanese or has original targetまたは, reading matawa, orthographic reading_kanaまたは and pronunciation_kanaまたわ; speech continues to use original target-script text.
matcher_parity: Existing accepted whole and sentence-reference paths retain precedence; starter is source-only and receives no full target translation.

Scan source using the frozen English Unicode-word/contraction convention, then require matching complete native word boundaries and exact UTF16 source text. In particular, do not match I inside I'm just because native tokenization splits it.
Preserve protected URL/email/code spans, uppercase identifiers exceptI, mid-sentence capitals, exact noun guards and initial interrogative+following-token conditions from frozen evaluator.
source_context_sets supplies exact noun guard sets. Question following lists are per-entry; no implicit morphology or guessed inflections.
Reject NFKC+casefold-identical source/target faces. Keep source offsets from original text; never normalize the displayed source.
Obtain nativeSourceTokenCount from actual platform tokenizer and nativeSourceTokens per unit. Reject partial native words; no verb-root slicing.

Apply existing native density budget at requested0.10 BEFORE choosing a unit; select at most1 budget-fitting unit by content-first,TRAINrank,longer-unit,sourceoffset. Do not override native budget to reproduce Python hit counts.
Feed the selected unit through existing SourceReferencePresentation validation and return only nonempty anchored partials; target offsets remain reference-local.
Default production remains the accepted existing pack unless root separately promotes; QA enablement must be explicit and captured.
capture_sequence: Freeze immutable app/test source and build closure.
Prepare only already-installed models; no model-download API, no remote translation calls.
Baseline: all240cases with starter disabled, fresh pair/conversation engines, immediate warm repeat percase. Preserve every raw provider string actually produced.

Candidate: same240cases/order/provider/assets with starterenabled and fresh isolated pair/conversation engines, immediate warm repeat percase. Preserve unavailable-provider failures and actual rejection reasons.
Retain counters for heavy lexical/frame alignment separately from cheap source-reference presentation validation.
Keep per-row output incrementally and exact source/build/input hashes. No hidden restart if run incomplete.
Compare source-only reach, actual calls, prepared-first/warm latency, native token/range integrity and changed depth; semantic review follows actual spans.
command_status: These new selectors are requested harness interfaces, not a claim that they already exist. Platform owners use their existing frozen build/VM wrappers and retain exact executed commands after adding them.
expected_invariants: Approved starter hit automatic:0 readiness/MT/heavyalignment; immediate cached repeat:0.
Misses retain unchanged current fallback and truthful provider/model limitations.
Explicit full action remains governed by already-qualified six-fixture routing contract; no need to repeat an MT call for everyhit in this coverage capture.
All selected JA spans carry exact supported readings; no missing-reading success.
No partial source words, identifier changes, fabricated whole translation, or stale-result publication.
limitations: Python one-unit results were not a hard10%cap; extra native-budget abstentions are expected evidence, not failures to tune away.
Known/already-learned word filtering and ongoing vocabulary progression remain unresolved.
These sources have been reviewed in prior target experiments; this is native qualification and paired runtime measurement, not a fresh blind language-coverage estimate.
